This is what happens when the government prints large amounts of money and floods the economy with stimulus spending. When the money supply increases faster than the supply of goods and services, each dollar can lose purchasing power.

COVID was badly mishandled by the government, and the massive spending and stimulus policies that followed contributed to the economic consequences we are still dealing with today.
